name: inkscape
description: 用本机 Inkscape 工具编辑 SVG 图形。

workspace_roots.title: INKSCAPE_MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOTS
workspace_roots.description: Required absolute directories, ';' separated on Windows. No default. Unset disables this MCP server. Do not use a drive root or a user profile path.

live_enabled.title: INKSCAPE_MCP_LIVE_ENABLED
live_enabled.description: Upstream default is true. This package defaults to false so install does not attach a GUI Inkscape.

raw_action_enabled.title: INKSCAPE_MCP_RAW_ACTION_ENABLED
raw_action_enabled.description: Upstream default is false. Leave false unless the operator opts into run_raw_action.
